messages:
mia: Pushed profiling run for model-x -> noticed a 15-25% tail increase on token-level latency when function-calls/structured-output validation is enabled.
devin: link to run: https://ci.internal/runs/9453 :eyes:
sam: do we see this on both A100 and T4? Might be kernel selection behaving differently.
mia: A100 shows smaller hit (~12%) but T4/GPUs with smaller L2 see 25%. Full diff attached (profiling snippet):
mia: ```
FRAME: token-gen
  kernel: attn_fused_v2  (fallback to attn_fallback for seq>1024)
  kv_cache_miss: 18%
  validation_time_per_token: 0.00042s
  batch_padding_overhead: 0.00031s
  total_token_latency: 0.0019s
```
devin: validation_time_per_token jumps when tool-call schema validation runs on the runtime thread instead of async worker. Could be sync RPC.
sam: we had a recent change to kernel chooser heuristics (PR #3214) that tightened sequence-length thresholds. Maybe it's forcing slower kernel on many requests.
perf-bot: perf alert: increase in p99 token latency for route /v1/chat-tool by +22% over baseline (24h). See dashboard: https://dash.redwood/route-chat-tool
tara: suggestion: add token-level breakdown per-route in new dashboard tile (client -> routing -> kernel -> validation -> kv_cache). That'll help distinguish kernel vs validation costs.
mia: I also noticed KV cache miss spikes on routes with function-calls (likely because validation touches structured outputs and serializes intermediate tokens). KV miss correlated with longer serialization.
devin: short-term mitigation: move validation to background async worker and return partial stream + validate result chase. Will add feature flag to toggle per-route.
sam: for the runtime, can we lower the sequence threshold in kernel chooser for T4 to avoid attn_fallback? or conversely prefer attn_fused_v2 for shorter seqs even if not optimal for long seqs.
tara: Ops: can we add a new per-route KPI: validation_time_per_token and kv_cache_hit_rate. Also show correlation scatterplot with batch_size.
mia: I'll open a tracking issue and add links to benches. /cc @devin @tara
devin: thanks — I'll prototype a canary that offloads validation and instrument the streaming handoff.
perf-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy started: runtime/validation-offload -> canary-7
sam: nice. keep notes brief in the issue so oncall can flip flag if needed. :thumbsup:
